instruction_summary: Give Codex the complete mother/universe data and all prior successful and failed research, restart from scratch, and search for the model with the strongest profit and win-rate evidence.
requirements: retain every successful, failed, rejected, aborted and abandoned experiment
use chronological causal point-in-time validation only
do not call any exposed 2023-2026 history a pristine holdout
optimize after-cost profitability and win rate jointly, not win rate alone
control drawdown, tail risk, turnover, sample size, regime stability and multiple testing
return NO_ROBUST_WINNER when evidence does not support a robust winner
